title: Forward Container Apps logs to the India-resident Wazuh SIEM declared for prod
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server, extend deploy/azure/bicep/main.bicep so the logs collected by task 1 leave the platform: wire the Log Analytics data to the Wazuh SIEM endpoint declared in applications/mcp-gateway/env/prod.json (India-resident, 365-day retention) via an Azure Monitor export or ingestion resource kept in the same template, so containerApp and managed-environment platform, console and audit logs finally reach the SIEM that prod declares but the template never feeds. Constraints: keep the destination configuration in the template rather than hand-set in the portal; SIEM credentials go through the secrets backend, never hard-coded in bicep; deploy through the releaseProcess order dev -> qa -> prod with the required approval; verify SIEM ingestion on qa before promoting to prod; no deploymentWindows are declared in sdlc/policy.json.
acceptanceCriteria: deploy/azure/bicep/main.bicep declares the export or forwarding resource that sends the Log Analytics tables to the SIEM endpoint recorded in applications/mcp-gateway/env/prod.json, with no endpoint or credential hard-coded in the template
After the qa rollout, the Wazuh SIEM lists the mcp-gateway container app as an active log source and shows qa platform and console log entries arriving within 15 minutes of generation
The forwarded logs land in the India-resident workspace (logsInIndia true) that retains them for the 365 days declared in applications/mcp-gateway/env/prod.json

verificationMethod.description: Review the post-deployment ingestion evidence attached to this task: the Wazuh log-source registration for the mcp-gateway container app and a sample of forwarded qa platform and console log entries; expected result: the SIEM shows live log flow from the qa environment within 15 minutes of generation and the merged bicep PR shows the forwarding resource.

rootCause.description: applications/mcp-gateway/env/prod.json declares a Wazuh SIEM with 365-day India-resident retention, but the deployment template never configures any forwarding path to it, so the declared SIEM receives nothing from mcp-gateway
